meta.title: Theme studio
meta.description: Puts a wallpaper behind the Web GUI, shows a custom title and icon above the conversation, and tints the sidebar logo. Open the panel from the palette entry in the left sidebar, or click the custom title; there you can upload a picture or paste an image address, set how much of it shows through the interface, set the header title and icon (an emoji, a short text, or an uploaded image), and pick a colour for the DeepSeek Harness mark at the top left. Changes apply immediately, are stored in this browser only, and the panel's Reset button clears them; removing the plugin restores the default look.
